voice.instruct: male, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent

scenes.say: Your brain is only two percent of your body weight.
scenes.caption: Your brain is only 2% of your body weight.
scenes.visual: Giant 2% slams in on 'two'; a long bar shows the tiny 2% sliver on 'body'.

scenes.say: But it burns about twenty percent of your energy.
scenes.caption: But it burns about 20% of your energy.
scenes.visual: Ring fills to 20% on 'twenty', counter follows; chip '2% -> 20%' pops on 'energy'.

scenes.say: Most of it keeps billions of neurons ready to fire.
scenes.visual: Grid of neurons pops in on 'neurons', orange ripple from the centre on 'fire'.
Cursor glides in and clicks a Follow pill on 'Follow'; it turns into Following with a check.
